message.content: {"note_claim": "The video is of F-22 Raptors at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson in Alaska in March 2022, not Greenland.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "36 U.S. Air Force F-22 Raptors assigned to the 3rd Wing launch and land at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson during Polar Force 22-4 in Anchorage, Alaska, March 31, 2022.", "reason": "The DVIDS page documents F-22s launching at JBER in Alaska in March 2022, substantiating the note's claim about the footage's origin, though it doesn't address the flip or Greenland troop numbers."}

parsed.note_claim: The video is of F-22 Raptors at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson in Alaska in March 2022, not Greenland.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 36 U.S. Air Force F-22 Raptors assigned to the 3rd Wing launch and land at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson during Polar Force 22-4 in Anchorage, Alaska, March 31, 2022.
parsed.reason: The DVIDS page documents F-22s launching at JBER in Alaska in March 2022, substantiating the note's claim about the footage's origin, though it doesn't address the flip or Greenland troop numbers.
